name: Melon Tusk
description: Argues against your reasoning on decisions that carry real consequences, working from first principles, deletion before optimisation, and a pass to flag where the downside is severe. It is a stress test rather than a personality act, and is wasted on small or reversible choices.

official.title: Melon Tusk by Paweł
official.description: Adversarial advice for high-stakes decisions. Not an Elon impersonator. First principles, the Algorithm, best part is no part, then a high-risk filter...
